name: Gemini 4 Argon
roles: contestant, AI judge, full checker of the report
card_line: Shot ideas for Flow, and my most rigorous judge.
quote: “Google renames products faster than I can update my bookmarks.”
quote_by: Tyler, in his stack scorecard, about Google

name: ChatGPT
how_it_ran: the ChatGPT app, Chat tab (the picker says Pro)
roles: contestant, judge two, AI judge, full checker of the report
card_line: Creative writing and language, and my second reader.
quote: “It is still the best general-purpose conversation on earth, and the one your mom uses, which is the real moat and always was.”

name: Claude
how_it_ran: the Claude app, Incognito, Fable 5.1 (Claude Opus 5.5 scored the answer key and wrote the reports)
roles: contestant (Fable 5.1); scorer and writer (Opus 5.5); by rule, no Claude model judged taste or reviewed the report
card_line: In my words: “no better PM than Claude,” and “Claude tells me whether or not an idea will work.”
quote: “Names its models after myths and fables so you can't tell which one you're paying for, and says ‘you're absolutely right’ so often it should be a drinking game.”

name: Grok
card_line: “Bottom line” logic “when it really matters,” it’s “excellent at coding tasks,” and its “pulse on the internet’s voice.”
quote: “Grok is the friend who says the thing out loud. Sometimes that gets it a time-out on its own platform. Sometimes that finds twenty holes in my safety screen before lunch. Same trait, both directions.”

name: DeepSeek
card_line: “It’s open source and gives me a non-Western lens,” and its reasoning, more than its research.
quote: “Trained for a fraction of what the big labs spend, gave NVIDIA the worst Monday in stock-market history, and stores your data in China - which it says right on the tin, which is more transparency than most apps on your phone manage.”

name: Qwen
card_line: Part of “the Asian lens,” and it brings “good dissenting data.”
quote: “The catch: it ships so many variants so fast that choosing one is a hobby.”

name: Kimi
roles: contestant, AI judge, full checker of the report
card_line: It “thinks harder,” it’s “really thorough,” and it’s part of “the Asian lens.”
quote: “I want to fist-bump model 3, for the word ‘trivially.’”
quote_by: Tyler, in Round 2, before the names came out. Model 3 was Kimi.

name: Vibe
card_line: It “really delivered on the comedy,” “it provides my French perspective,” and it’s a “strong research door.”
quote: “Europe's entire AI industry is one company in Paris that named its coding agent ‘Vibe’ and its chat app ‘The Cat,’ and I love it like a puppy.”

name: GLM
card_line: SecondSignal’s best dissenter. It gets hard problems right cold, and it “tends to think hard, and produce good, thoughtful data.”
quote: “The rule underneath the whole roster: agreement between models that can see each other's work is worth nothing. Disagreement that survives contact is the product.”

name: Perplexity
how_it_ran: the Perplexity app, Deep Research, with Best choosing the model
card_line: Deep research with the sources attached, and many models through one door.
quote: “Citations are its whole personality, and I mean that as a compliment.”

name: Manus
how_it_ran: the Manus app, Manus 2.0 Max at Ultra
card_line: It measures before it advises, and it finds the hole nobody asked about. Still new to me.
quote: “I'm really impressed by Manus… but I have to admit that I haven't played with it long enough to know how far I can stretch it, what I can make it do.”

name: Hermes Agent
how_it_ran: open source, on my PC, model nous/welcome on Nous Portal
card_line: Top two on every Round One board, answers that bring their sources, and built to do far more than chat. Still new to me.
quote: “Hermes seems to allow you to create agents there. I got a little excited when I saw that.”

name: Nemotron 3 Ultra
card_line: It runs the long ones. One of its long test conversations led Claude to a real hole in my safety layer, and when the right model ran, it tied at the top of the answer key.
quote: “Measurement, not opinion, so the fast cheap model is the right model.”
quote_by: Tyler, in his stack scorecard, on Nemotron’s job

name: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL
card_line: It ran in place of Nemotron 3 Ultra, and my file name kept the record. So it got its own score, and its own profile.
quote: “The file name is the record.”
quote_by: Tyler’s rule, as The Track Record puts it
profile_pdf_original_name: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL - Model Ledger profile.pdf

name: Mistral Medium 3.5
card_line: The clean test of Mistral, and the outside voice that checked me.
quote: “I'm not married to any of these. I'm married to finding out.”

name: Muse Spark Open
card_line: Meta’s Muse Spark caught my attention, and in Round One this open version planned the edit, not just the clips.
quote: “I'm not mad. I'm a Llama user watching his ex get famous.”
quote_by: Tyler, in his stack scorecard, on Meta
profile_pdf_original_name: Muse Spark Open - Model Ledger profile.pdf

name: Moondream 3 Preview
card_line: A test drive for my creative stack. It’s a vision model, built to read images, and Round One was text only, so its real test is still ahead.
quote: “I was curious about how it might be able to impact my creative stack… I just wanted to take it for a test drive.”

name: Sonar Pro
card_line: Perplexity’s own model, one I’ve used and miss, put on the record where I could reach it.
quote: “I would love to run Sonar again, if Perplexity would bring it back. Nudge, nudge, Perplexity…”

name: Sonar Reasoning Pro
card_line: Its shots were among my favorites, until the judges’ notes on filmability changed my mind.
quote: “I want to see literally every shot on this list! This was one of my favorites!”
quote_by: Tyler, on its shots, 17 October, before he knew whose they were
profile_pdf_original_name: Sonar Reasoning Pro - Model Ledger profile.pdf

name: Sonar Deep Research
card_line: I ran all three Sonars to learn what each one offers, and this one researches.
quote: “I was really trying to learn more about what the different models of Sonar had to offer.”
profile_pdf_original_name: Sonar Deep Research - Model Ledger profile.pdf
